# Survey – generated by the "question‑me" skill

## Round 1

Plain-language background: each runner (the worker program that picks up tasks) will get a build identity — a fingerprint of the exact code it started with. Runners will report this fingerprint in their regular check-ins, along with whether their code changed on disk after they started. The Settings page will show the fingerprint and warn when a runner looks stale. Per your earlier answer, stale runners are warned about, never blocked — blocking happens only for a real version incompatibility.
